description:
Check a domain before your agent trusts a link, a sender or a counterparty: does it exist, where does its mail go, SPF and DMARC policy, nameservers, DNSSEC. Free tier (preview). For registration age, registrar, parking detection and a 0-100 risk score use the paid x402 endpoint /v1/domain.

[DomainCheck via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as DomainCheck's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: domain $0.002 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: domain $0.002. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
